prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin to establish rules for [adoption, new_flow], [adoption, redesign], [finish, new_flow], [finish, new_screen], [sign_in, notification], and [sign_in, reorder] since each kind of change has only one test so far.
Evidence for [finish, redesign] is mixed across 2 tests: one test won (+5.6% after noise correction), while the other showed no clear effect (-1.2% after noise correction).
Predictions were consistently too high for tests that performed poorly and stopped early ([adoption, redesign], [sign_in, reorder], and [finish, new_screen]).
Predictions were too high for tests where no clear effect was seen, including [finish, redesign] in round 6 (predicted +5.0%) and [sign_in, notification] in round 9 (predicted +2.0%).
Predictions were consistently too low for winning tests, including [finish, redesign] in round 4, [finish, new_flow] in round 7, and [adoption, new_flow] in round 8.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +7.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_flow: +10.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -6.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, notification: +1.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -8.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 64.7%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 79.4%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 23.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Multi Step Validation Flow: Guide users through photo selection with interactive validation steps on image framing and lighting before uploading. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel (64.7%) and 3 support emails reported custom pet generation failing or looking wrong.)
1: [home, new_screen] Desktop Pet Spawn Diagnostic Screen: Add a dedicated diagnostic check screen prior to desktop launch to verify screen overlay permissions and window rendering. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop or the app failing to open during launch.)
2: [finish, new_flow] Pet Controls Quick Action Guided Flow: Introduce an interactive walkthrough component on home intro showing pet hiding, movement, and chat shortcuts. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion regarding how to control, hide, or interact with the pet after setup.)
3: [home, wait_info] Generation Progress Activity Feed: Add a live step-by-step progress activity log during the waiting screen to display pet asset compilation status. (why: The waiting step has a median duration of 201s (mean 2336s), causing drop-off while pet files compile.)
4: [adoption, hint] Pet Personality Preference Hints: Add contextual helper hints under pet selection options detailing companion activity levels and desktop behavior. (why: Adoption conversion is low (64.7%) with high median duration (89s), indicating choice paralysis.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Readiness Completion Banner: Display a high-visibility completion badge on the final home screen confirming desktop readiness. (why: Overall onboarding completion is only 23.2%, requiring clearer signal when setup is complete.)
6: [adoption, layout] Pet Persona Trait Spotlight Grid: Switch friend selection screen to a grid layout emphasizing activity styles and interactive features. (why: Adoption conversion is the lowest step conversion rate across the funnel at 64.7%.)
